messages:
Jordan P: Quick thread — Customer A asked for an EU-first rollout for their tenant (low-latency), plus a strict telemetry contract before full cutover. Need final plan for canary slices, flag naming, rollback criteria, and who signs the telemetry.
Liz M: +1. Can we scope minimal launch: 5% EU traffic, shadow in NA for 24h, then 25% if signals good?
Mike G: 5% sounds fine. We should pre-warm dedicated pools and pin a variant: `model-eu-v1-quant`. Also need autoscale buffer + burst capacity enabled.
Sam O: Ops note — we need a kill-switch that can flip traffic to global fallback within <30s. Who owns that?
Ada S: SRE will own the fast kill. Suggest circuit-breaker tied to error-rate OR tail-latency > 3s sustained for 2m. Rollback automation should do: 1) scale down new variant 2) route to fallback variant 3) page oncall.
Priya C: From CS: Customer A requires a telemetry contract: token-level latency, per-tenant error rate, and sample payloads for first 48h. They want delivery cadence: daily for first week, then weekly.
Jordan P: OK. Telemetry owners? Product owns contract, Eng-platform owns collection, SRE owns SLO/alerts. Agree?
Liz M: Agree. Product will draft a short SLA appendix and data retention note for customer.
Mike G: For flagging, propose naming convention: `custA.eu.optin.v{n}`. Canary config as JSON snippet:
```
{"canary": [{"slice": "random-5pct", "duration": "3h"}, {"slice": "region-eu-25pct", "duration": "24h"}], "fallback": "model-global-v2"}
```
This lets us run quick 3h micro-canary then stabilize.
Sam O: Ops wants a guard: no promo or high QPS campaigns during canary window. Also pre-authorize emergency scale to +40% capacity for first 6h.
Ada S: Add telemetry gates: sample rate at 100% for request/response headers, 10% for full payloads. If regression in semantic-quality (customer eval) >5% fail, auto-rollback.
Priya C: Customer will run their eval set. Need a shared prompt set and baseline. They asked for a webhook that posts daily summary to their staging channel — we can expose that via Console hooks?
Mike G: Console can send webhooks. Add API key rotation window and mask PII in samples. We'll provide a sanitized payload schema.
Jordan P: Launch checklist draft (short):
- Flag created: `custA.eu.optin.v1` (owner: Product)
- Canary schedule: 5% x 3h -> 25% x 24h -> ramp (owner: Eng-Platform)
- Telemetry contract signed (owner: Product + CS)
- SLO/alerts set (owner: SRE)
- Kill-switch and automations tested in staging (owner: Ops + SRE)
- Customer daily webhook set up + sample masking (owner: Eng-Platform + CS)
- Rollback policy: auto on latency/error/quality gates or manual by oncall (owner: SRE + Product)
Liz M: Add stakehold approvals: Legal signoff on data sharing, and Security approval for KMS usage.
Sam O: Ops will run the cutover at 09:00 UTC next Tuesday if everyone signs off. Please confirm by EOD Friday.
Jordan P: I’ll chase approvals. Who volunteers to test the kill-switch in staging? @Ada S / @Sam O?
Ada S: I will run kill-switch tests tomorrow 14:00 UTC, will post runbook logs here.
deploy-bot: checkpoint created: canary-plan/custA-eu/1752504329 by Jordan P
Priya C: Customer requested a heatmap of latencies by region at T+6h and T+24h. Can we commit?
Mike G: Yes, will produce heatmap + token-cost delta.
Jordan P: Great. Final action items: Product: draft telemetry appendix; Eng-Platform: flag + webhook + pre-warm plan; SRE: SLO/kill-switch automation; Ops: run cutover and verify capacity. EOD Friday for signoffs. :thumbsup:
